typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFilePath as string (),
	AuthFileName as string (),
	AuthOBFileName as string (),
	AuthRecCount as integer (),
	AuthTermFileName as string (),
	AuthTermRecCount as integer (),
	ConfFileName as string (),
	ConfOBFileName as string (),
	ConfOBQuery as string (),
	ConfRecCount as integer (),
	ConfTermFileName as string (),
	ConfTermRecCount as integer (),
	InboundFileLocation as string (),
	PWD as string (),
	ResRecCount as integer (),
	ResTermRecCount as integer (),
	RestFileName as string (),
	RestOBFileName as string (),
	RestOBQuery as string (),
	RestTermFileName as string (),
	RUNID as string (),
	Server as string (),
	ToFolder as string (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		End as string,
		N_FIRST as string,
		N_MID_INIT as string,
		N_LAST as string,
		N_SUFFIX as string,
		I_SSN as string,
		D_DOB as string,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER as string,
		F_EMPLOYEE as string,
		C_PREFIX as string,
		I_CONTRACT as string,
		I_HCID as string,
		C_INDIV_REL as string,
		C_ANT_ENT as string,
		C_AUTH_TYPE as string,
		C_AUTH_DOC_TYPE as string,
		D_AUTH_BEGIN as string,
		D_AUTH_END as string,
		N_SIGNED_FIRST as string,
		N_SIGNED_LAST as string,
		N_TITLE as string,
		N_AUTH_FIRST as string,
		N_AUTH_MID as string,
		N_AUTH_LAST as string,
		N_AUTH_SUFFIX as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_HOME as string,
		T_PHONE_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_HOME as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_WORK as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_WORK as string,
		T_PHONE_WORK as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_WORK as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_CELL as string,
		T_PHONE_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_CELL as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_INT as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_INT as string,
		T_PHONE_INT as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_INT as string,
		T_DETAILS as string,
		F_NOTES as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(RunId = toInteger($RUNID),
		FileType = toString(trim('AUTH_TERM')),
		DOB = iif(isNull(D_DOB) || length(trim(D_DOB)) == 0, toDate(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString((substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_DOB), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		AuthEffectiveDate = iif(isNull(D_AUTH_BEGIN) || length(trim(D_AUTH_BEGIN)) == 0, toDate(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString((substring(toString(D_AUTH_BEGIN), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_AUTH_BEGIN), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_AUTH_BEGIN), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		AuthExpirationDate = iif(isNull(D_AUTH_END) || length(trim(D_AUTH_END)) == 0, toDate(toString('1900-01-01', 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString((substring(toString(D_AUTH_END), toInteger(1), toInteger(4)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_AUTH_END), toInteger(5), toInteger(2)) + '-' + substring(toString(D_AUTH_END), toInteger(7), toInteger(2))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(RunId = RunId) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_CELL as string,
		D_AUTH_END as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_INT as string,
		N_TITLE as string,
		C_ANT_ENT as string,
		F_EMPLOYEE as string,
		N_AUTH_LAST as string,
		C_PREFIX as string,
		I_SSN as string,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_WORK as string,
		N_SIGNED_FIRST as string,
		T_PHONE_INT as string,
		N_SIGNED_LAST as string,
		N_AUTH_FIRST as string,
		N_MID_INIT as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_CELL as string,
		C_AUTH_DOC_TYPE as string,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_HOME as string,
		N_SUFFIX as string,
		N_LAST as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_WORK as string,
		T_DETAILS as string,
		N_FIRST as string,
		N_AUTH_SUFFIX as string,
		I_HCID as string,
		T_PHONE_HOME as string,
		D_AUTH_BEGIN as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_WORK as string,
		T_PHONE_CELL as string,
		F_NOTES as string,
		FILETYPE as string,
		RUNID as string,
		T_PHONE_WORK as string,
		C_INDIV_REL as string,
		D_DOB as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		C_PHONE_AREA_HOME as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_CELL as string,
		C_PHONE_AREA_INT as string,
		C_PHONE_EXT_INT as string,
		I_CONTRACT as string,
		C_AUTH_TYPE as string,
		N_AUTH_MID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_CELL,
		D_AUTH_END = AuthExpirationDate,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_INT,
		N_TITLE,
		C_ANT_ENT,
		F_EMPLOYEE,
		N_AUTH_LAST,
		C_PREFIX,
		I_SSN,
		C_HIPAA_GENDER,
		C_PHONE_AREA_WORK,
		N_SIGNED_FIRST,
		T_PHONE_INT,
		N_SIGNED_LAST,
		N_AUTH_FIRST,
		N_MID_INIT,
		C_PHONE_EXT_HOME,
		C_PHONE_EXT_CELL,
		C_AUTH_DOC_TYPE,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_HOME,
		N_SUFFIX,
		N_LAST,
		C_PHONE_EXT_WORK,
		T_DETAILS,
		N_FIRST,
		N_AUTH_SUFFIX,
		I_HCID,
		T_PHONE_HOME,
		D_AUTH_BEGIN = AuthEffectiveDate,
		C_COUNTRY_CODE_WORK,
		T_PHONE_CELL,
		F_NOTES,
		FILETYPE = FileType,
		RUNID = RunId,
		T_PHONE_WORK,
		C_INDIV_REL,
		D_DOB = DOB,
		C_PHONE_AREA_HOME,
		C_PHONE_AREA_CELL,
		C_PHONE_AREA_INT,
		C_PHONE_EXT_INT,
		I_CONTRACT,
		C_AUTH_TYPE,
		N_AUTH_MID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
